ack_policy: Normal segments: capture raw final before simulated ordered display ACKs; first persistence is observed independently. Cancel slot: observe persisted prefix but do not ACK it before stop, so no candidate can commit if completion races.
cancel_acceptance: Exact active foreground registration before actual session cancel; matching request/generation cancellation metrics and retirement required. Race is NOT_EXERCISED; no replacement or retry. Continue the final fixed whole slot only if ownership cleanup is confirmed.
stop_rule: Infrastructure, source, protocol, application or cleanup failure stops later slots. Cancellation race is recorded separately and makes final runtime acceptance fail without replacing the request.
scope: Actual remote HTTP text through ordinary Workstation submit/persist/delivery APIs. Simulated display ACK is not browser paint or sound. No local model/service startup, Kimi probe/inference, memory scheduler, camera/PTZ enable, microphone or TTS request. Normal Workstation idle local-owner construction remains real. No new broad quality claim.
early_persistence_acceptance: Record first_persisted_before_final_observed separately. RUNTIME_PASS is route/contract/source/ownership acceptance and does not imply the polling observer saw a segment before final; no browser/latency claim is inferred.
per_slot_deadline_scope: The entire slot including setup, existing throttle wait,Submit,observation,ACK and retirement is wrapped in110seconds; production HTTP retains its independent90second budget.
